stem_text: A person pushes a box on a rough horizontal platform surface. He applies a force of 200 N over a distance of 15 m. Thereafter, he gets progressively tired and his applied force reduces linearly with distance to 100 N. The total distance through which the box has been moved is 30 m. What is the work done by the person during the total movement of the box?

candidate_solve.derivation: First phase (0 to 15 m): Force F1 = 200 N is constant. Work W1 = 200 N * 15 m = 3000 J. Second phase (15 to 30 m): Force decreases linearly from 200 N to 100 N over displacement delta_x = 15 m. Work W2 = ((200 + 100) / 2) * 15 m = 150 * 15 = 2250 J. Total work done W = W1 + W2 = 3000 + 2250 = 5250 J. Matches Option B.
candidate_solve.limiting_cases: If force remained 200 N throughout 30 m, W = 6000 J. If force dropped to 0 N at 30 m, W = 3000 + 1500 = 4500 J. With linear drop to 100 N, W = 5250 J exactly.

concept_model_selection.evidence: Partition of work into constant force phase and linear decay phase

reasoning_chain_length.evidence: Calculate W1 and W2 independently and sum
